Purpose

Index of Knowledge Base copy-paste templates shared by AI, developers, and business authors.

---

Scope

Template index only. One template per document kind — no audience-specific duplicates.

---

## Templates

| Template | Use when |
|----------|----------|
| [WIDGET_TEMPLATE.md](./WIDGET_TEMPLATE.md) | New widget doc under `04-widgets/<category>/` |
| [MODULE_TEMPLATE.md](./MODULE_TEMPLATE.md) | New or filled module under `03-modules/` |
| [API_TEMPLATE.md](./API_TEMPLATE.md) | New or filled API surface under `05-api/` |
| [DECISION_TEMPLATE.md](./DECISION_TEMPLATE.md) | Non-ADR decisions |
| [ADR_TEMPLATE.md](../06-decisions/ADR_TEMPLATE.md) | Architecture Decision Records |

## Rules

1. Copy the template; do not edit the template file for a real document.
2. Keep one shared template per kind (AI / developers / business use the same structure).
3. Fill metadata before body content.
4. Use cross-reference sections even when values are `—`.
5. Pass [QUALITY_CHECKLIST.md](../QUALITY_CHECKLIST.md) before Approved/Production.
